published.source: Race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16): Orc; verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 1016.3 as a Human on the same sim)

summary: Forever's melee hunter: Survival with a cat, built on Expose Prey into Mongoose Bite. The pet deals about 18% of the damage.
rotation: Pre-pull: walk into melee at -6s, Aspect of the Beast at -3s, Hunter's Mark at -1.5s
Racials, potions and other cooldowns on cooldown
Hunter's Mark (rank 4, +143 ranged attack power) 1.5s before the pull and again in its last 3s; the raid's mark is off
Mongoose Bite whenever Expose Prey (or a dodge) opens it
Raptor Strike queued on the next swing when ready
Wing Clip in free GCDs (mana >= 50%), held when an opened Mongoose Bite is about ready
consumes: Dense Sharpening Stone (main hand and off hand)
caveats: The pet takes 10% of the hunter's ranged attack power, its crit and its hit, on its own 254 attack power (beta pet sheets).
Assumed: Raptor Strike rank 8 adds 96, halfway between the client and Era.
Left out: Fire-toasted Bun (+9, seasonal) and Elemental Sharpening Stone (Molten Core plans).
Crit per Agility is Classic's at 60 (0.0189% a point), from Forever's game files.
Pet hits scale with attack speed, as a level 17 pet sheet shows. A 1.0s raptor would add about 2 (Savage Rend), but none that fast is known.
Survival never shoots, so the ranged weapon doesn't matter.
Immolation Trap adds 10% of ranged attack power over the trap (Blizzard's notes, no log).
Mark duty is assumed: the hunter keeps up its own Hunter's Mark, and the raid's mark is off. That costs about 0.5 to 2.5 DPS at 180s (1.5 here).

Scorpid Sting isn't a duty: it shares Insect Swarm's 2% hit-reduction slot, which Balance druids keep up for its own damage, so a hunter on it would pay for nothing (a ranged hunter about 85 to 100 DPS, Serpent Sting's slot).
notes: Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_sv, the hunter_presets.sh rotation); it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions. Every hunter keeps up its own Hunter's Mark (standards 23, Mark duty assumed), so the raid's debuffs.huntersMark is off. Distance is 5 yd as in the mksettings raid the number was measured in (the UI preset starts at 25 yd; the APL walks in 6s before the pull, which the preset says costs nothing). Survival keeps a 1.0s cat out (DefaultOptions). Orc since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Human.
